SUPERB ENERGY EFFICIENT 2 & 3 BEDROOM HOUSES ON THE GRAND CANAL GREENWAY
by Springwood Ltd.

Designed to offer stylish living in a great location, surrounded by the exceptional
amenities in Sallins Village, on the Grand Canal Greenway and just a few minutes
walk to Sallins / Naas Train Station. At Mill Harbour modern design and construction
delivers the very best in thermal and sound insulation ensuring each house achieves
the highest standards for residents.
The houses at Mill Harbour are designed to maximise use of space and light to deliver efficient, elegant and practical homes. Brick, render and zinc facades set the tone as you step inside the bright entrance hall leading to the flowing living, dining and kitchen space. Most houses feature a dramatic double height space that opens to the patio and private garden offering a tasteful extension of living space. In addition to the shaker style fitted kitchens, all houses have a separate utility room. WC with shower and at least one bedroom downstairs.
Large master bedrooms are ensuite with feature bay windows and are fitted with large contemporary wardrobes.
Bathrooms and ensuites boast clean lines and quality fittings. Pull-down stairs lead to fully floored attic space.
Patios provide an elegant extension of living space and walled rear gardens are seeded. It's all part of a quality specification brought to you by the experienced team at Springwood Limited, to offer modern comfort, convenience and lasting quality at Mill Harbour, a home designed for life.

Idyllic Living in the Heart of Kildare
Mill Harbour offers residents a dynamic hub on the banks of the Grand Canal, merging a unique blend of village convenience, leisure amenities, countryside and great transport links. Steeped in railway heritage
and set along the water, the village enjoys a distinctive charm. A selection of cafés, restaurants, shops, and local services foster a welcoming and vibrant community atmosphere.
Outdoor enthusiasts will enjoy scenic walking and cycling routes right from their doorstep, while excellent transport links provide easy access to Dublin and surrounding towns. Combining natural beauty, rich
history, and modern connectivity, Sallins offers an exceptional quality of life in one of Kildare's most desirable locations.

A train to the city, a waterway to enjoyment.
Sallins began as a small hamlet in the late 1700s and grew around the Grand Canal, where horse-drawn barges carried grain, coal, and turf, bringing trade and life to the area. The arrival of the railway later boosted its growth, and local mills and factories provided work for
generations and the village amenities expanded. Today it is an energetic commuter town where many take the train to work in the city and return home to enjoy leisure pursuits along and on the water.
A Gateway to an Exceptional Active Lifestyle
Life in Sallins is shaped by an active, outdoor lifestyle supported by outstanding amenities and a strong community spirit. The Grand Canal Greenway offers a continuous, traffic-free route for walking and cycling, linking Sallins with Hazelhatch and extending deep into the countryside. Residents enjoy a wide range of leisure options through well-established local clubs, including Sallins GAA Club, Sallins Town AFC, and the Sallins & Naas Cycling Club. The canal itself adds unique charm, with opportunities for kayaking, fishing, or relaxing barge trips that showcase the area's beauty and
heritage. Complementing its outdoor appeal, Sallins also offers a growing selection of cafés, pubs, and restaurants, providing welcoming social spaces for everything from casual coffee catch-ups to evening dining with friends. Local pubs retain a traditional character, while nearby Naas expands the choice with an excellent variety of dining and nightlife options. Beauty salons, hair studios, and wellness services within the village and surrounding area ensure residents enjoy both convenience and quality
close to home. Golfers are well catered for with the nearby Naas Golf Club, Palmerston and The K Club, while Mondello Park, Naas Racecourse, Punchestown and the Curragh Racecourse provide high-energy entertainment close to home. Together, these amenities ensure that recreation, social life, and everyday comforts are always within easy reach for the Mill Harbour resident.

Each Mill Harbour home is covered by the 10 year HomeBond Guarantee Scheme.
